tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/async-runtime.md <<'EOF'
# Async runtime

This project uses Tokio as its async runtime. The decision rests on Tokio being the de facto standard in the Rust ecosystem and on its broad ecosystem support.
EOF
cat docs/policies/async-runtime.md
tool_input.description: Create the async runtime policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/async-runtime.md`. It says the project uses Tokio as its async runtime, because Tokio is the de facto standard and has broad ecosystem support.

That comes from decision #24, the current record, so the file doesn't mention the retired alternatives.

The first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool instead. Muninn's session context also reported that 20 hook runs started and never finished, which points to a hook exceeding its timeout. I didn't investigate that.
